code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M','NEP':'H'}
# ---- recompute per-moiety contacts for the two GTPs of 2FP4 (provenance for panel B) ----
txt=S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2FP4.pdb",timeout=120).text
prot=[];gtp=defaultdict(list)
for l in txt.splitlines():
    if l[:6] in ("ATOM  ","HETATM"):
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        x=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
        if rn in AA3: prot.append((l[21],int(l[22:26]),AA3[rn],x))
        elif rn=="GTP": gtp[l[22:27].strip()].append((l[12:16].strip(),x))
P=np.array([a[3] for a in prot])
BASE={"N9","C8","N7","C5","C6","O6","N1","C2","N2","N3","C4"}; RIB={"C1'","C2'","O2'","C3'","O3'","C4'","O4'","C5'","O5'"}
counts={}
for key in ["403","404"]:
    c={}
    for moi,names in [("base",BASE),("ribose",RIB),("phosphates",None)]:
        at=[(n,x) for n,x in gtp[key] if (n in names if names else (n not in BASE and n not in RIB))]
        L=np.array([x for n,x in at])
        d=np.sqrt(((P[:,None,:]-L[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min(1)
        c[moi]=len({(prot[i][0],prot[i][1]) for i in np.where(d<4.2)[0]})
    counts[key]=c
print("contact counts:",counts)

# ---- census (from the GraphQL + contact survey above) ----
census=[("1CQI","E. coli","ADP",1,"beta"),("1JLL","E. coli","(CoA only)",0,"-"),
        ("2FP4","pig","GTP",2,"beta"),("2FPG","pig","GDP",1,"beta"),
        ("7JFP","pig","GDP",1,"beta"),("7JMK","pig","GDP",1,"beta"),
        ("7JJ0","pig","GMPPCP",1,"beta"),("7JKR","pig","GMPPNP",1,"beta"),
        ("3UFX","T. aquaticus","GDP",1,"beta"),
        ("6NO0","Blastocystis","ADP",1,"beta"),("6NO1","Blastocystis","ADP",1,"beta"),
        ("6NO2","Blastocystis","ADP",1,"beta"),("6NO3","Blastocystis","ADP",1,"beta"),
        ("6NO4","Blastocystis","ADP",1,"beta"),("6NO5","Blastocystis","ADP",1,"beta")]
cav_beta=[342,314,55,55,54,43]; cav_alpha=[31,31,24,21,21]
cons=[("G55b/G80","G","G","G"),("K56b/K81","K","K","K"),("G57b/G82","G","G","A"),
      ("K64b/K90","K","K","-"),("G65b/G91","G","G","G"),("H68b/H94","H","H","K")]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,9.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,hspace=0.42,wspace=0.28)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
labels=[f"{p} ({o})" for p,o,l,n,s in census]
vals=[n for *_,n,s in census]
cols=["#d1495b" if v==2 else "#30638e" if v==1 else "#bbbbbb" for v in vals]
ax.barh(range(len(vals)),vals,color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(vals))); ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=8)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("nucleotide molecules modelled per alpha-beta unit")
ax.set_xticks([0,1,2])
ax.set_title("Nucleotides in succinyl-CoA synthetase structures\nall sit on the beta subunit; 2FP4 has a second one",fontsize=10)
for i,(p,o,l,n,s) in enumerate(census):
    ax.text(n+0.05,i,f"{l}",va="center",fontsize=7.5)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
w=0.35; x=np.arange(3); moi=["base","ribose","phosphates"]
ax.bar(x-w/2,[counts["403"][m] for m in moi],w,label="GTP 403 (catalytic, site I)",color="#30638e")
ax.bar(x+w/2,[counts["404"][m] for m in moi],w,label="GTP 404 (second, surface)",color="#d1495b")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(moi); ax.set_ylabel("protein residues within 4.2 A")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_title("2FP4: the second GTP has no base-reading pocket\n(site I reads guanine via Gln20b; site 404 is held by Lys56b, Lys64b)",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.bar(range(len(cav_beta)),cav_beta,color="#30638e",label="beta subunit (2FP4 chain B)")
ax.bar(np.arange(len(cav_alpha))+len(cav_beta)+1,cav_alpha,color="#8f9779",label="alpha subunit (4XX0 chain A)")
ax.axhline(300,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
ax.text(len(cav_beta)+1.2,315,"approx. volume of a guanine nucleotide",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_ylabel("cavity volume (cubic angstrom)"); ax.set_xticks([])
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Ranked cavities, ligands deleted (LIGSITE, PSP>=6, 1.2 A grid)\nlargest alpha cavity is 31, the catalytic beta pocket is 342",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); ax.axis("off")
tbl=[["pig / Dicty position","pig SUCLG2","Dicty scsB","E. coli SucC"]]+[[a,b,c,d] for a,b,c,d in cons]
t=ax.table(cellText=tbl[1:],colLabels=tbl[0],loc="center",cellLoc="center")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(9); t.scale(1,1.6)
for j in range(4): t[0,j].set_facecolor("#dfe6ec")
for i in range(1,len(tbl)):
    if tbl[i][3]!=tbl[i][1]: t[i,3].set_facecolor("#f5d5d5")
ax.set_title("Residues lining the second GTP site of 2FP4\nconserved pig to Dictyostelium, degraded in E. coli",fontsize=10)
plt.show()
